purpose: Use the canonical HENGCE mother to define the stock universe, retrieve authorized Fugle broker-structure content, preserve raw payload lineage, and measure PIT/coverage feasibility before any preregistration or forward-return inspection.

transport.stage_2_unlock_rule: broker_id and broker_type must first be observed from a verifiable authorized raw source; never guess or select brokers based on outcomes

raw_payload_contract.empty_response_rule: Record request receipt as EMPTY; do not create a synthetic data observation and do not convert empty to zero.
raw_payload_contract.overwrite_rule: Never silently overwrite a different raw payload. Preserve retrieval lineage and hashes.
raw_payload_contract.idempotency_rule: Identical request plus identical raw SHA256 is idempotent and may be referenced without duplication.

pit_audit_requirements: Identify every date/time field returned by Fugle and its semantic meaning.
Establish when each observation became knowable to the researcher.
Prohibit use before its verified information-availability time.
Do not backfill missing broker observations from later snapshots.
Do not treat current broker identities or branch labels as historically stable unless source lineage proves stability.
coverage_audit_requirements: Report nonempty payload rate over the full 1092-name canonical mother-derived universe.
Report date span and observation counts per symbol for each broker content family.
Report missingness by date, liquidity, listing age and market segment before any forward return is opened.
Report schema variation and field-level null rates.
No manual deletion of difficult or missing symbols from the denominator.
release_sequence: write per-request receipts and raw SHA256
run universe/date coverage and missingness audit
adjudicate PASS or DATA_BLOCKED without inspecting forward returns
only if PASS: freeze minimal incremental-ranking preregistration
